title: Concept: Python requirement pinned to a prerelease
description: requirements.txt declares an exact pin to a PEP 440 prerelease build, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Prerelease builds carry no stability promise and sit outside most advisory ranges, so a known defect can ship while the pin looks deliberate.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: Prerelease builds carry no stability promise and sit outside most advisory ranges, so a known defect can ship while the pin looks deliberate.
